title: [E16-06] Idempotent Commands and Replay-Safe Mutations
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-06 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to make mutation handlers idempotent, so I can prevent duplicate transactions.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Infrastructure  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** C — Controlled pilot — after operational gates  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** Expanded product scope; no PDF story mapping  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:C`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E16-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/30), [E16-01](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/32)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E16-11, E16-01.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Repeated command/webhook does not create duplicate liabilities or status transitions.
- [ ] Define idempotency key scope, payload binding, retention and replay response.
- [ ] Apply deduplication to acceptance, reservations, progress, payables and settlement recording.
- [ ] Reject key reuse with conflicting payload and make concurrent identical commands safe.
- [ ] Preserve operation outcomes across transient failures without duplicate domain events.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use operation ledger and unique database constraints inside transactions; external provider references receive independent uniqueness checks.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Concurrently replay one mutation, reuse key with changed amount and interrupt/retry a command; verify exactly one business effect.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.
